housing.text: As an Orange County supervisor, Wagner supported a state budget priority backing a proposed $10 billion affordable housing bond.
housing.quote: Workforce and Affordable Housing Budget Request Support the proposed 2026 Affordable Housing Bond for $10 billion.

health.text: Wagner supported county requests for additional state funding for health care and behavioral health services.
health.quote: We need more funding to flow out of Sacramento to the communities that provide these services.

voting.text: Wagner supports requiring voters to show identification and says he would implement and defend the voter ID initiative if it passes.
voting.quote: Don Wagner fully supports the Voter ID Initiative on the ballot in November.

safety.text: Authored AB 392, which restricted when police may use deadly force and required that it be used only when necessary to defend human life.
safety.quote: it is the intent of the Legislature that peace officers use deadly force only when necessary in defense of human life.

voting.text: Weber has opposed voter-identification requirements and supports vote-by-mail and automatic registration to expand participation.
voting.quote: Weber instead supports policies aimed at expanding participation among eligible voters, including vote-by-mail ballots and automatic registration.
